verdict.rationale: Stripe's payouts docs say funds go from the available balance to the bank as payouts, and that Instant Payouts can be sent any time and usually arrive within 30 minutes. Terminal payments are managed in the same Stripe Dashboard as online payments, so this payout flow covers Terminal funds. Missing for 10: evidence of per-payout arrival-date visibility, any next-day payout option, Terminal-specific payout documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
